interest: Tracing a lost American leather shipment to Shanghai, 1945–46.
overview: February 5, 1946 instruction asking Shanghai to trace Dungan, Hood & Co.'s leather shipped on the SS President Van Buren.

people.name: Mr. Penrose
people.role: Representative of Dungan, Hood & Co., Inc. and author of the enclosed letter

subfiles.about: The Department of State instructs the American consular officer in Shanghai to investigate the status of a commercial leather shipment sent to the Vienna Shoes Company and determine procedures for recovering the goods or obtaining compensation.
subfiles.summary: State asks the Shanghai consulate to trace leather shipped by Dungan, Hood & Co. on the SS President Van Buren in September 1945 and advise on recovery.
subfiles.title: Instruction from Department of State to American Consular Officer in Charge at Shanghai regarding leather shipment by Dungan, Hood & Co., Inc.
subfiles.to: American Consular Officer in Charge, Shanghai
